epic.name: channel-adoption
qualityGates: The converted skill runs to completion under headless `claude -p` (no TTY) without hanging on a former AskUserQuestion gate
Headless run with empty $STATE_DIR/events takes the documented default for every former gate and completes
The converted SKILL.md references $SCREEN_DIR (option/progress cards) and $STATE_DIR/events (rulings)
No new experimental["claude/channel"] live-push is declared (passive-bus floor only)
decisions: Passive bus only: capabilities:{tools:{}} + $SCREEN_DIR cards out / $STATE_DIR/events JSONL in. No live-push (interactive-only, inert headless).
Shared server scripts/digital-griot-mcp/digital-griot-mcp.ts is READ-ONLY reference — unchanged by every story.

The uniform conversion recipe: (1) detect non-interactive run; (2) replace each AskUserQuestion / interactive-subagent gate with write-card-to-$SCREEN_DIR + read-$STATE_DIR/events; (3) fall through to a documented default when events is empty — never block; (4) emit progress cards at phase boundaries.
ALL implementation routes through /prism:cl-plugin-structure (Griot-suite gold-standard rule).
prism-init dual-listing resolved to CONVERT (T-ceremony, light-touch, safe default = do NOT overwrite).
No browser cockpits / visual-companion.md for converted skills — the bus card is load-bearing; the cockpit is an optional accelerator (out of scope).
outOfScope: Building browser cockpits / visual-companion.md for the converted skills
Any change to the shared digital-griot-mcp server or its transport
Converting the SKIP set (prism, cl-plugin-structure, fragment-sync)
Building the durable run_device_skill(skill,args,answers) MCP invocation verb
risks: A default fallthrough that is unsafe (e.g. auto-overwrite, auto-discard, auto-commit) would make a headless run destructive — every default must be the least-destructive choice.
A skill that still gates on AskUserQuestion anywhere will hang headless — conversions must be exhaustive per skill, not partial.
prism-closing-ceremony orchestrates bookend/docs-update/release — it is only headless-safe once those three are.

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-release
stories.description: Convert prism-release to a passive-bus channel surface via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its interactive gates (semver increment choice; the push confirmation; GitHub-release + native-build confirmations) with option cards written to $SCREEN_DIR and rulings read from $STATE_DIR/events. Emit a progress card per build/release step. Defaults when events is empty: accept the commit-derived semver increment; per B12 a release means work is wanted upstream so push proceeds; build the standard asset set. Emits: version-increment card, push-confirm card, per-step progress cards.

steps.description: Invoke /prism:cl-plugin-structure to drive the conversion to Prism patterns
Add a `## Headless Channel Surface` section documenting the bus contract, cards, and defaults
Replace each AskUserQuestion gate (increment / push / build / GH-release) with $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read + default fallthrough
Emit a progress card at each build/release step
Headless smoke-run under `claude -p` (empty events → defaults; seeded events → ruling honored)

context.why: prism-release is a proven headless-hang offender in the release chain; it is the highest-value ceremony surface for cloud/CI operation.
risks: The push default must respect B12 (always push on release) yet never push a half-built release — gate the default behind a successful build.
edgeCases: No commits since last tag (increment card should offer 'no-op')
Native build target unavailable on the headless host

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-bookend
stories.description: Convert prism-bookend via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its version-increment confirmation and docs-snapshot confirmation with a $SCREEN_DIR option card + a $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: accept the commit-analysis-suggested semver increment and take the snapshot. Emit progress cards for analyze → suggest → snapshot → sync.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (bus contract + increment card + default)
Replace the increment/snapshot confirmation gate with card + events read + default

context.why: bookend is invoked by closing-ceremony; its headless-safety is a prerequisite for the one-pass wrap.
risks: A wrong default increment ships the wrong version — surface the reasoning on the card so a watching operator can override.
edgeCases: Ambiguous commit history where the increment is not clearly major/minor/patch

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-docs-update
stories.description: Convert prism-docs-update via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace the source-file selection and the VitePress-page overwrite confirmation with a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: use the newest PRISM-DOCUMENTATION-*.md and apply the update. Emit progress cards per page updated.

steps.description: Replace source-select + overwrite-confirm gates with card + events read + default (newest doc, apply)

context.why: Second link in the closing-ceremony chain; must run clean headless in cloud.
risks: Overwriting hand-edited VitePress pages — the card must show which pages change.
edgeCases: Multiple candidate PRISM-DOCUMENTATION-*.md files present

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-init
stories.description: Convert prism-init via /prism:cl-plugin-structure (light-touch). Its only interactive gate is the overwrite confirmation when a .prism/ already exists — replace with a single $SCREEN_DIR option card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: DO NOT overwrite (safe, non-destructive). Emit a progress card for the scaffold result.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (single overwrite card + safe default)
Replace the overwrite confirmation with card + events read + default = no-overwrite

context.why: Dual-listed; resolved to CONVERT because 'init prism' is a top-level surface that prompts on an existing dir.
risks: A destructive default would wipe an existing .prism — default MUST be no-overwrite.
edgeCases: Fresh repo (no gate needed) vs existing .prism (card shown)

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-sideload
stories.description: Convert prism-sideload via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace any build-target / output-path confirmation with a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: produce the standard Cowork sideload zip at the conventional output path. Emit progress cards for pack → zip → report.

steps.description: Replace target/path confirmation with card + events read + default

context.why: Sideload builds the Cowork-uploadable zip — the exact artifact a cloud operator produces headless.
risks: Stale cache reuse if the default path collides with a prior zip
edgeCases: Output dir missing → create vs fail

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-finish
stories.description: Convert prism-finish via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Its core gate is the structured option menu (merge / PR / cleanup / discard) — replace with a $SCREEN_DIR option card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: the LEAST-DESTRUCTIVE option (create/keep PR + keep branch; NEVER discard). Emit a progress card for the chosen action.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (finish-options card + safe default)
Replace the merge/PR/cleanup/discard menu with card + events read + default = least-destructive

context.why: finish presents destructive options; unattended it must default to the safe branch.
risks: 'discard' as a default would delete work — explicitly forbidden as a fallthrough.
edgeCases: No open PR to update
Dirty working tree

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-closing-ceremony
stories.description: Convert prism-closing-ceremony via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. It orchestrates the Review & Audit gate → bookend → docs-update → release in one pass; each embedded gate becomes a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read, and the Review & Audit verdict is emitted as a card. Default when events is empty: proceed through each sub-ceremony using that sub-skill's documented default, honoring each sub-skill's own HITL gates (push, GH release). Emit a progress card at each ceremony boundary. BLOCKED until its three sub-skills are headless-safe.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` documenting the per-ceremony cards + the Review & Audit verdict card
Replace embedded gates with card + events read + per-sub-skill defaults (fail-fast preserved)
Emit a boundary progress card between Review&Audit → bookend → docs-update → release
Headless smoke-run of the full one-pass chain under `claude -p`

context.why: The one-pass release wrap is the flagship cloud-headless ceremony; it only works once its sub-skills do.
risks: A sub-skill still hanging headless would stall the whole ceremony — depends on STORY-001/002/003.
edgeCases: Review & Audit gate FAIL → ceremony must stop with a verdict card, not proceed

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-plan
stories.description: Convert prism-plan via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its interactive 'present understanding → per-section approval' loop and clarifying questions with $SCREEN_DIR cards (an understanding card, then a per-section approval card) + $STATE_DIR/events reads. Default when events is empty: proceed with the drafted plan and mark it Status: awaiting-review (never present as user-approved). Emit progress cards per plan section.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (understanding + per-section approval cards; awaiting-review default)
Replace the interactive approval loop with cards + events read + default

context.why: Planning is the most interactive core surface; its AskUserQuestion loop is the canonical headless-hang.
risks: A headless plan must not claim human approval it never got — default status = awaiting-review.
edgeCases: Unresolved unknowns that would normally block finalization

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-implement
stories.description: Convert prism-implement via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its phase-verification checkpoints ('proceed to next phase?') with a $SCREEN_DIR checkpoint card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: proceed to the next phase ONLY if that phase's automated verification passed; otherwise stop and emit a blocked card. Emit a progress card per phase.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (checkpoint card + verification-gated default)
Replace each phase checkpoint with card + events read + default (advance iff verified)

context.why: Phase checkpoints are interactive gates that stall a headless implement run.
risks: Advancing past a failed verification silently — default must gate on the phase's automated checks.
edgeCases: Verification command missing for a phase

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-design
stories.description: Convert prism-design via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its design-approach approval and source questions with $SCREEN_DIR cards + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: proceed with the drafted architecture/design (mermaid + contracts + data models) marked awaiting-review; skip the interactive source prompt and use provided/ledger sources. Emit progress cards per design section.

steps.description: Replace approach-approval + source questions with cards + events read + defaults

context.why: Design gates on user buy-in and source selection — both hang headless.
risks: Materializing a .pen without a chosen source — default to ledger/provided sources only.
edgeCases: No brainstorm ledger present

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-iterate
stories.description: Convert prism-iterate via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its plan-update approval and 'which changes to re-implement' questions with $SCREEN_DIR cards + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: apply the drafted iteration (plan delta + re-implementation) marked awaiting-review. Emit progress cards for plan-delta → re-implement.

steps.description: Replace approval/selection gates with cards + events read + default

context.why: Iterate combines plan-update + re-implement; both inherited interactive gates.
risks: Re-implementing changes the operator did not intend — surface the delta on the card.
edgeCases: No prior plan/implementation to iterate on

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-brand
stories.description: Convert prism-brand via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its logo-seed selection (pick among 12 divergent seeds) and mark-refinement choices with $SCREEN_DIR option cards + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: carry the top-ranked seed forward and emit all 12 as a card for later human choice (do not lock a brand unattended). Emit progress cards per stage (seeds → refine → system).

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (seed-selection card + top-ranked default)
Replace seed/refinement selection with cards + events read + default

context.why: Brand identity is a high-taste human choice; headless must surface options, not silently lock one.
risks: Auto-committing a brand identity the human never picked — default surfaces, does not finalize.
edgeCases: No brand-profile source present

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-eval
stories.description: Convert prism-eval via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its 'which skills/versions to evaluate' and benchmark-confirm prompts with a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: evaluate the current skill version against the immediately previous version and emit the report. Emit progress cards per eval run.

steps.description: Replace selection/confirm gates with card + events read + default (current vs previous)

context.why: Eval is a producer surface an operator wants to launch headless and watch.
risks: Running an unbounded benchmark set unattended — default to the current-vs-previous scope.
edgeCases: No previous version to compare against

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-capture
stories.description: Convert prism-capture via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its source-vocabulary questions with a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: capture the provided references as-is into the capture ledger and flag unknown source fields rather than prompting. Emit a progress card for the captured ledger.

steps.description: Replace source questions with card + events read + default (capture as-is, flag gaps)

context.why: Capture front-loads source Q&A that blocks a headless run.
risks: Losing source provenance — default flags missing fields instead of dropping them.
edgeCases: No references provided at all

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-prd
stories.description: Convert prism-prd via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its requirements clarifying questions with $SCREEN_DIR cards + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: draft the PRD from the provided scope and mark open requirements as explicit gaps (do not invent). Emit progress cards per PRD section.

steps.description: Replace clarifying questions with cards + events read + default (draft + flag gaps)

context.why: PRD generation is Q&A-heavy; unattended it must draft-and-flag rather than block.
risks: Fabricating requirements to fill a gap — default marks gaps explicitly.
edgeCases: Sparse scope input

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-visual-docs
stories.description: Convert prism-visual-docs via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its flow/wireframe scope questions with $SCREEN_DIR cards + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: generate user flows / wireframes / screen inventory from the provided context and mark assumptions. Emit progress cards per artifact.

steps.description: Replace scope questions with cards + events read + default

context.why: Visual-docs gates on scope questions before generating artifacts.
risks: Generating the wrong flow scope — surface assumptions on the card.
edgeCases: No UX context provided

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-codex-plan-sync
stories.description: Convert prism-codex-plan-sync via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Its interactive gate is the Gavel ceremony that resolves codex OPEN decisions — replace each OPEN decision with a $SCREEN_DIR option card + $STATE_DIR/events read (mirroring the gavel decision surface). Default when events is empty: leave OPEN decisions UNRESOLVED (HITL-safe; never auto-resolve) and still perform the non-decision bidirectional sync (git commit-scope reverse channel). Emit a card per OPEN decision + a sync progress card.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (OPEN-decision cards; unresolved default)
Replace the Gavel resolution gate with per-decision cards + events read + default = leave unresolved
Emit OPEN-decision + sync progress cards; keep the reverse-channel sync running headless

context.why: The codex<->prism-plan bridge resolves decisions interactively via Gavel; unattended it must sync but not auto-decide.
risks: Auto-resolving an OPEN codex decision headless — explicitly forbidden; default leaves them open.
edgeCases: No OPEN decisions (pure sync path)

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-research
stories.description: Convert prism-research via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. It already fans out non-interactive Task agents; add the passive-bus surface (additive) — emit a progress card per dispatched agent (locator/analyzer/pattern-finder/web) and a 'research complete' card. Replace any scope-narrowing question with a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read defaulting to the broad scope. Emits: per-agent progress cards, completion card.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (per-agent progress cards; broad-scope default)
Replace any scope question with card + events read + default

context.why: Research is a long fan-out; progress cards let a headless operator watch the parallel agents.
risks: Additive change must not gate the fan-out on any card.
edgeCases: An agent returning empty

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-decompose
stories.description: Convert prism-decompose via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its story-boundary / epic-bundling confirmations with a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: emit the drafted stories.json + epic bundling and mark it for review. Emit progress cards per epic bundled.

steps.description: Replace boundary/bundling confirms with card + events read + default

context.why: Decompose is the queue-builder for Spectrum; it should run headless to feed autonomous loops.
risks: Wrong story boundaries emitted unattended — mark output for review.
edgeCases: Very large spec exceeding a single pass

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-subagent
stories.description: Convert prism-subagent via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace its interactive review-outcome / retry decisions (two-stage review) with $SCREEN_DIR cards + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: follow the bounded-retry policy automatically (retry within bounds, then mark blocked) — never wait on a human. Emit a progress card per task + review stage.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (review-outcome cards; bounded-retry default)
Replace review/retry gates with cards + events read + default (bounded policy)

context.why: Subagent-driven execution already has a bounded-retry policy — headless just formalizes the default.
risks: Infinite retry if the bound is not enforced as the default
edgeCases: A task failing both review stages

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-dispatch
stories.description: Convert prism-dispatch via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Replace any 'which domains to fan out' selection with a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: dispatch all identified independent domains. Emit a progress card per dispatched domain + a merge card.

steps.description: Replace domain-selection with card + events read + default (dispatch all)

context.why: Dispatch fans out independent domains; headless should launch all by default.
risks: Selecting a subset silently — default is all identified domains.
edgeCases: Domains with hidden shared state (should not be dispatched in parallel)

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-spectrum
stories.description: Convert prism-spectrum via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. It already runs autonomous per-story sessions with a <spectrum-*> signal protocol; add the passive-bus surface — emit a progress card per story (start / gates / signal) and turn any quality-gate-fail human decision into a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: follow the signal protocol (retry within bounds → <spectrum-retry>, then <spectrum-blocked>). Emits: per-story progress cards + gate-fail card.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (per-story progress + gate-fail cards; signal-protocol default)
Map quality-gate-fail decisions to card + events read + default = signal protocol

context.why: Spectrum is the autonomous loop itself; the cards make its overnight run observable without changing the signal contract.
risks: Card logic must not interfere with the <spectrum-*> signal protocol spectrum.sh parses.
edgeCases: Gate failure at the retry bound → <spectrum-blocked>

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-validate
stories.description: Convert prism-validate via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. Add the passive-bus verdict surface (additive) — emit a progress card per verification command and a final verdict card. Replace any manual-verification confirmation with a $SCREEN_DIR card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: run all automated checks and report manual-verification items as UNVERIFIED-MANUAL (do not block, do not claim pass). Emits: per-check + verdict cards.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (per-check + verdict cards; unverified-manual default)
Replace manual-verification confirmation with card + events read + default

context.why: Validate is the ship gate; a headless operator most wants its verdict as a card.
risks: Claiming a manual item passed unattended — default is UNVERIFIED-MANUAL.
edgeCases: A verification command that itself prompts

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-verify
stories.description: Convert prism-verify via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. It drives Playwright via the browser-verifier agent (already headless-capable); add the passive-bus surface (additive) — emit a screenshot/console-assertion verdict card + per-assertion progress cards to $SCREEN_DIR. No AskUserQuestion gate exists, so the default is simply the assertion-derived pass/fail (no fallthrough decision needed). Emits: per-assertion + verdict cards.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (verdict + per-assertion cards; no gate to remove)

context.why: Verify is additive: no hang risk, but its screenshot/verdict is exactly what a headless operator wants surfaced.
risks: Over-building — keep it additive; do not introduce a gate where none exists.
edgeCases: Playwright unavailable on the headless host

stories.title: Headless channel surface: prism-debug
stories.description: Convert prism-debug via /prism:cl-plugin-structure. It fans out non-interactive investigator agents (log/state/git); add the passive-bus surface — emit a findings card per investigator, and replace the post-investigation 'which hypothesis to pursue' selection with a $SCREEN_DIR option card + $STATE_DIR/events read. Default when events is empty: proceed with the highest-confidence hypothesis and record the alternatives on the card. Emits: per-investigator findings cards + hypothesis card.

steps.description: Add `## Headless Channel Surface` (findings + hypothesis cards; highest-confidence default)
Replace hypothesis selection with card + events read + default

context.why: Debug fans out investigators then asks the human to pick a hypothesis — that pick hangs headless.
risks: Pursuing a low-confidence hypothesis silently — record alternatives on the card.
edgeCases: Investigators disagree with no clear top hypothesis
